replacements.zh-CN: 有限而统一的色彩秩序

replacements.en: a limited, unified color order drawn from the subject's own colors
replacements.zh-CN: 取自主体自身配色、有限而统一的色彩秩序

replacements.en: a limited, unified color order of beige, navy and rust
replacements.zh-CN: 以米色、藏蓝与赭红为主、有限而统一的色彩秩序

replacements.en: a limited, unified color order of off-white, black and vermilion
replacements.zh-CN: 以米白、黑与朱红为主、有限而统一的色彩秩序

replacements.en: a limited, unified color order of red, yellow and blue primaries with black and white
replacements.zh-CN: 以红黄蓝三原色和黑白为主、有限而统一的色彩秩序

replacements.en: Unless the subject explicitly calls for it, do not generate text, logos, watermarks, borders or UI, and do not make a multi-image collage.
replacements.zh-CN: 除非主题明确要求，否则不生成文字、Logo、水印、边框、UI，不做多图拼接。

replacements.en: Add one short sans-serif English title to the bottom half as part of the poster composition; do not generate logos, watermarks, borders or UI, and do not make a multi-image collage.
replacements.zh-CN: 可在下半部分加入一行简短的英文无衬线标题，作为海报构成的一部分；不生成 Logo、水印、边框、UI，不做多图拼接。

replacements.en: Add one short sans-serif Chinese title to the bottom half as part of the poster composition; do not generate logos, watermarks, borders or UI, and do not make a multi-image collage.
replacements.zh-CN: 可在下半部分加入一行简短的中文无衬线标题，作为海报构成的一部分；不生成 Logo、水印、边框、UI，不做多图拼接。
